From: aditya_rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>

Date: Sun, 12 Sep 2026 08:42:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Fwd: Marketly renewal & capacity needs — benchmark results attached

Hi all —

I ran the targeted benchmark against the anonymized Marketly corpus we were given. Attached: redwood_bench_Marketly_20260912.csv (per-run metrics) and a 1-page summary here. Key takeaways:
- Config tested: Dedicated x4 A100-equivalent (shared kernel profile), quantized (8-bit) and float16 runs.
- p50/p95/p99 (quantized): 13ms / 78ms / 210ms
- p50/p95/p99 (float16): 12ms / 72ms / 180ms
- Cost implication: quantized reduces token cost by ~12% relative to float16 for this workload; switching to a dedicated pool with autoscale set to min=2/max=8 reduces overall cost variability and improves p95 stability.
- Notes: tail spikes correlate strongly with long-context prompt batching; recommend pre-warming KV cache for planned Black Friday windows.

I recommend proposing a 2x committed capacity uplift for the first quarter (gives headroom for peak windows) and enabling prefix caching + conservative batching. Pilot SLA target: p95 < 85ms for the test corpus.

Attachment: redwood_bench_Marketly_20260912.csv

--
Aditya Rao
Head of Inference Ops | Redwood Inference

Lauren / team —

- Limit: discount applies only if they commit to the dedicated capacity profile we define for the pilot and provide a 30-day notice before any scale-down after the initial quarter.

I’ll draft the concession language and a short mutual action plan (dates, success metrics, pilots) for Lauren to send.

Monica
Customer Success Manager

Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:22:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Marketly renewal & capacity needs — proposal and next steps

Hi Emily —

Thanks again for the clarity on timelines. We ran the targeted benchmark and pulled together a short, actionable proposal:

1) Pilot & bakeoff: 1-week dedicated pilot using a Redwood-dedicated pool configured as discussed (min=2 / max=8), with quantized and float16 variants captured. Success metric: p95 latency < 85ms on the agreed corpus and throughput target of 350 reqs/s sustained. Measurement will be via the shared runbook (link below).

2) Commercial offer: 12% net discount on list for first 3 months of the renewed term + $20k usage credits if Marketly signs a 12-month renewal and accepts a temporary 2x committed capacity uplift for Q1 to cover peak windows. Discount and credits conditioned on using the dedicated capacity profile for the pilot.

3) Operational recommendations: enable prefix/KV pre-warm for scheduled peak windows; conservative batching to smooth tails; enable the suggested quantized profile to capture cost savings (~12% token-cost reduction).

Attachments: SLA_proposal_Marketly_20260914.pdf (pilot SLA and measurement plan), redwood_bench_Marketly_20260912.csv (raw metrics), proposed_mop_bakeoff.md (scope and test plan).

Proposed next steps:
- Kickoff alignment call (30 min) on Thu 16 Sep at 10:00 PT to agree corpus & instrumentation.
- Schedule the 1-week pilot to start Mon 20 Sep if aligned.

If this looks good, I’ll route the formal amendment and mutual action plan to procurement. Happy to jump on the call with you and your infra team.

Best —
Lauren
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
